title: WPMS/1639/2019 of SWATI KESARWANI Vs RAKESH KESARWANI

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1639 of 2019
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Mohit Maulekhi, learned counsel for
the petitioner and Mr. P.S. Bisht, Advocate, holding
brief of Mr. Siddhartha Singh, learned counsel for the
respondent.
Petitioner is the wife, while respondent is
husband. There was dispute regarding custody of
children born out of the wedlock pending before
learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Nainital. One
case numbered as Civil Case No. 01 of 2016 was
filed by petitioner (wife), while Civil Case No. 04 of
2016 was filed by respondent (husband).
By means of this writ petition, petitioner had
sought a direction to the court concerned to expedite
hearing of both the cases.
This Court vide interim order dated 31.05.2019
granted interim custody of the children to the
petitioner for a period of ten days, on account of
summer vacation in the school of the children. The
interim order dated 31.05.2019 was extended till
20.06.2019. Thereafter, the parties were sent for
mediation vide order dated 20.06.2019.
As per the report of the Mediator, the parties
have arrived at amicable settlement and they have
decided to live together. The mediation report is part
of record.
Today, both the parties are personally present
in Court. Petitioner (wife) made a statement that she
has no grievance left now and she and her husband
are living happily together at Haldwani. Petitioner
and respondent, who are present in Court, submit that
they have decided to withdraw all cases pending
before various courts/forums, within three weeks
from today. Petitioner further submits that she does
not want to press the present writ petition.
Mr. Mohit Maulekhi, learned counsel for the
petitioner submits that in view of the subsequent
developments, the writ petition may be dismissed as
withdrawn.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as
withdrawn.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Aswal 07.08.2019
